name: Media Viewer
description: Play video files directly in Nimbalyst
author: Nimbalyst Team

marketplace.tagline: Play video files directly in the editor
marketplace.longDescription: Open an mp4 in a tab and watch it without leaving Nimbalyst. Video streams from disk as you scrub, so a long screen recording opens as fast as a short one.
highlights: Play mp4 files in a tab, with scrubbing and playback controls
Streams from disk instead of loading the whole file into memory
Keeps your workspace context while you watch
